scope: Wuhan v8 storage-retrofit drainage network, Engineering36 subset, 10-min rolling real-time control research.

base_inflow_contract.reason: The frozen Wuhan RTC network excludes sanitary base inflow; event forcing is rainfall only.

variable_speed_pumps.meaning: variable-speed setting, NOT to be binarised

facility_semantics.all_others: remaining 33 facilities treated as binary-or-continuous according to their INP/link type; no facility beyond the 3 named above may be coerced through binary toggle logic.

PFV.definition: Sum over priority nodes (sentinel set) of flooding * dt, accumulated over the evaluation window. Priority nodes are defined by data/project6_v3_sentinel_nodes.txt.

TFV.definition: Sum over ALL network nodes of flooding * dt, accumulated over the evaluation window.

Peak.definition: Maximum of the summed node flooding rate (m3/s) over the evaluation window. Computed separately for each trajectory (Candidate and Reference); NOT the peak of the difference series.
forbidden_alternatives: delta-at-peak-time (TFV difference evaluated at the time of one trajectory's peak)
accumulated TFV used in place of TFV rate

delta_convention: Candidate - Reference. Positive delta means Candidate is WORSE than Reference for PFV/TFV/Peak (higher flood). Direction classification uses sign(delta); dead zones apply (see dead_zones).

PFV.note: Passive is flagged reference_degenerate=true in the current aug1 generation because its post-checkpoint action sequence equals No-control's. PFV-vs-Passive is therefore a duplicate of PFV-vs-No-control and must not be counted as independent evidence.

TFV.note: Current aug1 data uses a frozen snapshot, NOT dynamic native rules. TFV-vs-Dynamic-Internal labels are invalid until the dynamic Internal branch is regenerated (Gate 8).

Peak.note: Peak label is additionally degraded by near-zero delta magnitude (98.5% within +/- 25 m3/h). Even with correct Dynamic Internal, Peak head may need dead-zone 3-class formulation rather than binary sign.

no_control_semantics.definition: All branches advance from the event start with the same native SWMM rules and no external Engineering36 writes. At the checkpoint, No-control holds all 36 managed facilities at 1.0 with time-gated priority-100 rules on every 10-min decision step.
no_control_semantics.override_target_sequence: {aid: 1.0 for aid in engineering36_canonical_order} for n_steps
no_control_semantics.verification_status: Gate 5R requires same-state prefix hashes plus post-checkpoint requested/target/actual/readback equality.
no_control_semantics.contract_note: The reference is all-1.0, not all-off. No native controls are removed before checkpoint. Post-checkpoint rules are appended and remain inactive before checkpoint. Five-minute sampled action replay is forbidden as a substitute for the native prefix.

dynamic_internal_semantics.definition: Dynamic Internal runs from the event start through checkpoint+120 min on the authoritative INP with all native SWMM [CONTROLS] enabled. No external Engineering36 override is applied in the H120 window.
dynamic_internal_semantics.prefix_replay: Forbidden for Gate 5R V3. Candidate, No-control, Hold-previous and Dynamic Internal each execute the same native INP logic from event start through the checkpoint.
dynamic_internal_semantics.post_checkpoint: SWMM rules compute actions from live depth/flow state
dynamic_internal_semantics.verification_status: Gate 5R V3 requires exact equality of the full 60-min hydraulic prefix hash and checkpoint pre-action state hash across all four branches.

passive_semantics.definition: Executable-passive policy: deterministic prefix replay of the executable_passive baseline trajectory up to checkpoint_min, then the executable-passive policy continues to run natively (or its frozen action sequence is applied as override, depending on branch variant).
passive_semantics.degeneracy_evidence: In aug1 generation, passive_anchor branch's override sequence equals no_control's (all 1.0) at every checkpoint_min >= 40 min, because the executable_passive baseline trajectory has converged to all-1.0 by that time.
passive_semantics.downstream_consequence: PFV-vs-Passive labels are literal duplicates of PFV-vs-No-control. The passive_anchor branch is retained as a fallback policy for online control but is NOT an independent training reference for PFV.
passive_semantics.independent_passive_required_when: A future contract revision requires a state-dependent passive policy that produces distinct actions from no_control at the operating checkpoint times. Such a policy must be defined physically, not manufactured to create label diversity.

hold_previous_semantics.definition: Freeze the actual Engineering36 settings observed immediately before checkpoint_min and hold them for 12 control steps using time-gated priority-100 rules. The native prefix remains unchanged.
hold_previous_semantics.note: In the current aug1 code, hold_previous and internal_current_action read from the same source (internal_detail at checkpoint_min) and therefore produce identical trajectories. This is a collision to be resolved when hold_previous is used as an independent reference.

exact_tolerances.note: Non-inferiority margins are all zero in this contract. Any positive delta is a violation. Downstream evaluators may introduce small numerical tolerances for SWMM reproducibility, but these must be recorded separately and must not be used to hide real regressions.

dead_zones.meaning: Deltas with absolute value below the dead zone are classified as 'neutral / non-inferior' rather than 'improved / degraded'. Used for 3-class head training. Does NOT affect the PFV/TFV/Peak non-inferiority gate, which uses exact tolerances above.

future_information_contract.rainfall_forecast_source: design hyetograph tail from the same rainfall file used for the simulation (known at decision time from the experimental design)
forbidden_features: future actions that would be taken by any policy

authoritative_swmm_contract.formal_evidence_must_come_from: pyswmm Simulation stepping on the authoritative INP

checkpoint_replay_contract.determinism_contract: Given the same INP, rainfall, and pre-checkpoint action sequence, post-checkpoint KPIs are deterministic. Any non-determinism is a defect.

split_contract.method: Frozen seeded event partition: 48 train, 8 model-validation, 8 challenge, and 16 reserve events
split_contract.determinism: Reproducible from event_id and frozen seed; no row-level split
split_contract.note: All rows of the same event fall into the same split. No event leakage between train and validation.

conflicts_with_v3.v4_value: TFV and Peak reference (via Dynamic Internal); PFV reference is No-control
conflicts_with_v3.reason: V4 dual-reference framework assigns No-control as the primary PFV reference and Internal as the TFV/Peak reference. V3 used Internal as the PFV benchmark, which is incompatible with the V4 research question (PFV preservation).
V4 promotes No-control from diagnostic to primary PFV reference because the research question is 'does the candidate preserve PFV relative to no control?'

conflicts_with_v3.v4_value: online safety benchmark; Passive is retained as a degenerate fallback
conflicts_with_v3.reason: V4 explicitly marks Passive as reference_degenerate=true; the safety fallback is Internal rules (dynamic, to be regenerated).

conflicts_with_v3.v4_value: internal_current_action renamed to hold_internal_snapshot (frozen); a new dynamic_internal_rules branch must be regenerated
conflicts_with_v3.reason: The aug1 generation used a frozen snapshot of the internal rules' past actions, not the dynamic native rules. This is a defect that must be repaired before TFV/Peak labels are trusted.

conflicts_with_v3.v3_value: executable_passive baseline treated as an independent reference
conflicts_with_v3.v4_value: passive_anchor flagged reference_degenerate=true in aug1 generation
conflicts_with_v3.reason: Empirical evidence shows the passive baseline has converged to no_control (all-1.0) by the checkpoint times used in aug1 generation.

author: Project6 agent, from Gate 0 audit evidence
